title: Width and Depth Limits Commute During Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.30729v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work established that the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits of residual networks commute at initialization when residual branches are scaled by $1/\sqrt{depth}$. In particular, the network output converges to the same limit whether width and depth tend to infinity sequentially or jointly. We extend this commutativity result to training in linear residual networks. Under the same $1/\sqrt{depth}$ residual-branch scaling (Depth-$\mu$P) and the $\mu$P width parameterization, we prove that, for any fixed number of gradient-descent steps with gradient clipping, the network output converges in $L^2$ along every joint width--depth growth path as both width and depth tend to infinity. Consequently, the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits commute throughout any finite training horizon. Without gradient clipping, the corresponding $L^2$ convergence does not hold in general, but we establish the weaker convergence in probability.

translated_title: 训练过程中宽度与深度极限的可交换性
translated_abstract: 近期的研究工作证明了，当残差分支以 $1/\sqrt{深度}$ 进行缩放时，残差网络在初始化时的无限宽与无限深极限是可交换的。特别地，无论宽度与深度是依次趋于无穷还是同时趋于无穷，网络输出都收敛到相同的极限。我们将这一可交换性结果扩展到线性残差网络的训练过程中。在相同的 $1/\sqrt{深度}$ 残差分支缩放（Depth-$\mu$P）和 $\mu$P 宽度参数化下，我们证明：在使用梯度裁剪的条件下，对于任意固定数量的梯度下降步数，当宽度和深度同时趋于无穷时，网络输出沿着每条宽度-深度联合增长路径按 $L^2$ 收敛。因此，无限宽与无限深极限在任何有限训练范围内都是可交换的。在不使用梯度裁剪的情况下，相应的 $L^2$ 收敛一般不成立，但我们建立了较弱的依概率收敛。
tldr: 本文将残差网络无限宽与无限深极限的可交换性从初始化阶段首次扩展到训练过程，证明了在Depth-μP参数化与梯度裁剪下，线性残差网络在任意有限训练步数内，网络输出沿宽度-深度联合增长路径按 $L^2$ 收敛且两极限可交换。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the commutativity of infinite-width and infinite-depth limits of residual networks from initialization to training, proving that under Depth-μP scaling with gradient clipping, the output of linear residual networks converges in $L^2$ along every joint width-depth growth path for any finite number of gradient descent steps.
